title: Old HVAC industry practices are holding us back and costing us money. But we can fix it.
summary: A Chicago homeowner uses thermostat logs, a Manual J and a space-heater test to show his furnace is about three times oversized, arguing correct sizing makes heat pumps easier and many quotes are inflated.

assertions.quote: even respectable, well-known installers in my area are routinely putting way more heating capacity into homes than those homes actually need
All you need to do is find a day where it was extremely cold

verdicts.note: Runtime-based load estimation is an established method for single-stage equipment, though less accurate for multistage or zoned systems.

assertions.quote: we can end up with 3 or sometimes even 4 times as much energy inside our homes than we spend to collect it
They’re just air conditioners equipped with an extra valve so they can operate in reverse to produce heat!
people getting $20,000 or even $30,000 quotes to install equipment
Because the heat pump part IS THE SAME THING as an AC replacement.
they’re fine for the heat pump that they *actually* need
their heat pump could produce all the heat they needed
in many places they just aren’t. Heck, they’re barely required here in the frozen tundra of Illinois.
Many folks would consider that an insurmountable barrier to electrification

verdicts.note: A substantial minority of homes, especially with 100A service, need panel or service work, though right-sizing and load management often avoid it.
